newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takeda Chemical seeks New York listing.
newsitem.headline: Takeda Chemical seeks New York listing.

text.p: Leading Japanese pharmaceutical company Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd said on Friday it was seeking a listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).
It said it was making the move as part of its medium- and long-term business plan but that no details had been decided.
"Listing in New York is included in our medium- and long-term business vision but nothing specific, including the timing of the listing, has been decided," a Takeda spokeswoman said.
Toyota Motor Corp, Japan's biggest carmaker, has said it hopes to list its shares on the NYSE by the year 2000.

Toyota's president, Hiroshi Okuda, said earlier this week that Toyota had already cleared financial requirements for the listing but some problems remained in the public relations area. He did not elaborate.
